verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Mixpanel-native capability to stream events onward to CRMs, ad platforms, or registrable webhooks. The Raw Event Export API and CSV exports are pull-based downloads, which are developer building blocks rather than forwarding to destinations. Warehouse Connectors and the listed partners (Census, mParticle, Vendo) move data into Mixpanel or are third-party tools, so they earn no credit.
